name: Alvvays
label: Polyvinyl
lede: A smoothie shop shift, a buried snowmobile, a stolen demo recorder and a flooded basement: how a Cape Breton songwriter's band made the year's No. 3 album on Pitchfork.

eras.title: A Cape Breton songwriter finds a guitarist
eras.text: Molly Rankin, raised on Cape Breton Island in a family of Celtic folk musicians, teams up with Prince Edward Island guitarist Alec O'Hanley. By 2012 the band has moved to Toronto, found its keyboard player and is working under a name it is about to lose.

years.src: Exclaim!: Alvvays, long journey to overnight success · Wikipedia: Alvvays
years.h: Molly Rankin releases a solo EP called She
years.p: Alec O'Hanley helps out on the record, which Rankin made with Roy Orbison in her ear.
years.xp:
Rankin is the daughter of John Morris Rankin of the Cape Breton folk group [[The Rankin Family|5bda7192-a859-4365-8c51-c77894f38212]]. She grew up on the island (Wikipedia says Mabou, Exclaim! says Judique) and wrote with neighbour [[Kerri MacLellan|aa4daa19-55bc-443c-ad9e-7374d1ad06dd]] long before Alvvays existed.

The pair who would become the band's writing core had met at a show by [[Two Hours Traffic|7f5258b4-05aa-4b12-a386-4c1d3c48051c]], O'Hanley's band at the time.

years.src: Exclaim!: Alvvays, long journey to overnight success · Wikipedia: Alvvays
years.h: O'Hanley quits Two Hours Traffic and the band moves to Toronto
years.p: Rankin, O'Hanley, bassist Brian Murphy and drummer Phil MacIsaac, the last two from PEI, start over in the city and take whatever day jobs let them tour.
years.xp:
Before they were Alvvays they played under several names, Logos among them, then settled on Always. After a UK dream pop band turned out to own that name, Exclaim! reports the spelling changed for search-engine reasons. Wikipedia adds that another band called Always was already signed to Sony.

Rankin has described the new spelling as keeping a shred of sentiment and nostalgia.

years.src: Exclaim!: Alvvays, long journey to overnight success · Wikipedia: Alvvays
years.h: Kerri MacLellan joins on keyboards
years.p: Rankin's old Cape Breton neighbour fills out the sound that the debut will be built on.
years.xp: Exclaim! dates her arrival to 2012; Wikipedia lists her among the five founding members in 2011.

eras.title: A smoothie shop, a snowmobile and a record deal
eras.text: Two songs written in boredom and bad weather put the band on blogs and then on Polyvinyl. The debut, recorded in Calgary, is a US college radio No. 1 by August 2014.

years.h: Chad VanGaalen records the debut in Calgary
years.p: The band picks VanGaalen because of his work on the band Women, and records at his Yoko Eno studio.
years.xp: VanGaalen plays guitars, programming and percussion, and Wikipedia says he also suggested the band take a group name. Graham Walsh adds tracking at his Basketball4Life studio, John Agnello mixes in Brooklyn and Greg Calbi and Steve Fallone master at Sterling Sound.

years.src: Wikipedia: Archie, Marry Me · CBC Music: Archie, Marry Me certified gold
years.h: 'Archie, Marry Me' is written in a snowed-in PEI farmhouse
years.p: Rankin and O'Hanley bury their snowmobile, and the single comes out April 6, 2013.
years.xp:
Rankin told interviewers the snowmobile was supposed to get them to the road. Her line, per Wikipedia: "We had a snowmobile to get to the road, but we ended up burying the snowmobile." The Archie of the title is fictional, borrowed from her cousin Archie Rankin, a geologist and musician.

Rolling Stone later ranked it No. 28 on its list of the best songs of the 2010s. CBC Music reported the song was certified gold a decade after release, and Wikipedia specifies US certification.

years.src: Wikipedia: Adult Diversion · Exclaim!: Alvvays, long journey to overnight success
years.h: 'Adult Diversion' is written behind a smoothie shop counter
years.p: Rankin wrote it during long solo shifts at a Toronto smoothie shop. Exclaim! calls the song a love song from the point of view of a drunk stalker.
years.xp: The Super 8 beach video gave the band unexpected momentum. About a month after the single, per Wikipedia, they signed with Canadian label Royal Mountain Records, which led to Polyvinyl in the US, who sold a limited 7 inch of it paired with 'Archie, Marry Me' to mail-order subscribers.

years.h: South by Southwest turns the buzz into a US deal
years.p: Strong SXSW sets and online response to 'Adult Diversion' bring Polyvinyl to the band, per Wikipedia.

yt: Archie, Marry Me live on KEXP
years.h: Alvvays comes out on three labels at once
years.p: Polyvinyl (US), Royal Mountain (Canada) and Transgressive (Europe) release the debut. Pitchfork gave it 7.6.
years.xp: Rolling Stone's Simon Vozick-Levinson called it an indie-pop wonder, and the record hit No. 1 on the US college chart on August 5, 2014. The album was shortlisted for the 2015 Polaris Music Prize and ranked No. 5 on Paste's best albums of 2014. Metacritic scored it 78.

eras.title: Bigger stages, darker songs
eras.text: Glastonbury and Coachella arrive, the drummer changes and the second album trades some of the debut's sunshine for undertow. Two Juno nominations turn into a win.

years.h: Glastonbury, a Juno nod and a Polaris shortlist
years.p: The band plays Glastonbury in 2015, and the debut earns Juno nominations for Breakthrough Group and Alternative Album of the Year.
years.xp: Coachella follows in 2016, per Wikipedia. The debut's Polaris shortlist was announced for the 2015 prize.

years.h: Phil MacIsaac leaves for graphic design; Sheridan Riley takes over drums
years.p: The band's original drummer steps away to work in design, according to Wikipedia.

years.h: 'In Undertow' brings in Norman Blake of Teenage Fanclub
years.p: The lead single of the second album has [[Norman Blake|164066ec-7360-4a94-9937-2b48fc5f7298]] on backing vocals and extra guitar.
years.xp: Rankin said the song came partly from wobbling along a shore picking up stained glass. The video, directed by Jo Garrity, puts Rankin in an astronaut helmet and won Best Editing in a Music Video at the 2017 New York City Independent Film Festival.

years.h: Antisocialites is recorded in LA, upstate New York and Toronto
years.p: Alec O'Hanley and John Congleton produce; the band mixes Pro Tools with a TASCAM 488 8-track. Pitchfork gave it 7.3.
years.xp: Sessions ran through Kingsize Soundlabs in Los Angeles, Tarbox Road Studios in Cassadaga, New York, and Union Sound Studios in Toronto. Metacritic scored it 77, NPR's Mike Katzif called 'In Undertow' a darker spiritual sequel to their breakthrough single, and Exclaim! named it the top pop and rock album of 2017.

years.cap: Alvvays at the Junos. Photo credit needed.
years.h: Antisocialites wins the Juno for Alternative Album of the Year
years.p: The band also lands a Group of the Year nomination and a second Polaris shortlist, the album's, for 2018.
years.xp: 'Dreams Tonite' picked up a SOCAN Songwriting Prize nomination the same year.

eras.title: Stolen demos, a flooded basement, a new bassist
eras.text: After Antisocialites the band goes quiet for years. A burglary, a flood and a pandemic border slow the next record, and the bass chair changes hands.

years.src: NME: Alvvays, the only thing I know is to put my head down · Exclaim!: Alvvays Revisit Teen Spirits to Find a New Buzz · Variety: Alvvays Interview
years.h: A thief takes Rankin's demo recorder, then the basement floods
years.p: The recorder held demos of 'Pomeranian Spinster', 'Easy On Your Own?' and 'Belinda Says'.
years.xp:
NME reported the stolen device held demos including 'Belinda Says', and that a basement flood the following day destroyed nearly all the band's gear. Exclaim! describes the recorder as holding post-Antisocialites demos and quotes Rankin calling it "extremely sensitive work". Variety adds the pandemic, which slowed everything, to the five-year gap.

The exact dates of the theft and flood are not given in the sources I found.

years.src: Wikipedia: Alvvays · Exclaim!: Alvvays Revisit Teen Spirits to Find a New Buzz
years.h: Brian Murphy departs; Abbey Blackwell steps in on bass
years.p: Founding bassist Murphy is out and Blackwell, who was living in Seattle during the pandemic, joins, per Wikipedia and Exclaim!.
years.xp: Wikipedia dates Blackwell's stint as 2021 to 2024 and describes it as a temporary replacement.

years.cap: Alvvays with Shawn Everett. Photo credit needed.
years.src: NME: Alvvays, the only thing I know is to put my head down · Variety: Alvvays Interview · Tape Op: Alvvays · Exclaim!: Alvvays Revisit Teen Spirits to Find a New Buzz
years.h: Shawn Everett makes them play the whole album twice in a day
years.p: Everett runs all 14 demos back to back with about 15 seconds between songs and 30 minutes between full takes, per NME.
years.xp:
Everett, known for work with Kacey Musgraves and the War on Drugs, talked the band out of its usual fussy approach and had them record straight to tape, according to Exclaim! and Variety. Alec O'Hanley told Tape Op, "We're more comfortable when we're uncomfortable artificially."

Sources differ on the room: NME says Sunset Sound and Tape Op says Everett's Los Angeles warehouse. The band also tracked parts in Toronto, including at Canterbury Music Co. with drummer Chris Dadge, and at the Tragically Hip's Bathouse studio in Kingston, Ontario.

eras.title: The record everybody was waiting on
eras.text: Blue Rev lands in October 2022, turns up at No. 1 on year-end lists at Exclaim! and Stereogum and No. 3 at Pitchfork, then collects a Juno and a Grammy nomination.

years.h: 'Pharmacist' is the first new music in five years
years.p: Pitchfork's Quinn Moreland called it overblown in all the right ways, and Stereogum ranked it first in its weekly best songs list.

years.src: Wikipedia: Easy On Your Own? · Tape Op: Alvvays
years.h: 'Easy On Your Own?' gets louder
years.p: Producer Shawn Everett built the song from feedback, distortion and glide guitar, and the band cites My Bloody Valentine's Loveless as a reference for it.
years.xp: Paste compared it to [[My Bloody Valentine|8ca01f46-53ac-4af2-8516-55a909c0905e]]. The single reached No. 32 on the US Adult Alternative Airplay chart, according to Wikipedia.

years.h: 'Belinda Says' arrives with 'Very Online Guy'
years.p: Pitchfork's Jamieson Cox called it a heartbreaking sketch of an unexpected pregnancy and a modern power-pop classic.
years.xp: The title nods to [[Belinda Carlisle|2925aac9-5474-4030-b8a3-4151107010b2]], who per Wikipedia posted that she was flattered by the song. The track got a Grammy nomination for Best Alternative Music Performance at the 66th Grammy Awards.

years.src: Wikipedia: Blue Rev · Album of the Year: Alvvays, Blue Rev · Polyvinyl: Blue Rev is named Pitchfork's Best New Music
years.h: Blue Rev: Pitchfork 8.8, Best New Music, No. 3 of 2022
years.p: Pitchfork gave the third album 8.8 and ranked it No. 3 on its list of the best albums of 2022. It calls it a triumph of power pop.
years.xp:
The review's line, as quoted by Polyvinyl and Album of the Year: "a triumph of power pop, a densely layered, witty, blithe, and beautiful record." Metacritic scored it 86 from 15 reviews. Exclaim! and Stereogum put it No. 1 on their year-end lists, Paste ranked it No. 3 and Rolling Stone No. 12.

In the US it reached No. 61 and in the UK No. 27, according to Wikipedia.

yt: Belinda Says live, Le Trabendo Paris
years.h: Live in Paris at Le Trabendo
years.p: A fan-shot clip of 'Belinda Says' from the Paris show on the Blue Rev tour.

years.h: Blue Rev wins the Juno and makes a third Polaris shortlist
years.p: It is the band's second Juno for Alternative Album of the Year, after Antisocialites in 2018.

years.h: Lukas Cheung takes over on bass
years.p: Wikipedia lists Cheung as bassist from 2024, replacing Blackwell.

years.src: Wikipedia: Belinda Says · CBC Music: Archie, Marry Me certified gold
years.h: 'Belinda Says' is nominated for a Grammy; 'Archie, Marry Me' goes gold
years.p: The Grammy nod is for Best Alternative Music Performance at the 66th Grammys, and CBC Music reports the 2013 debut single passed gold certification a decade on.
